title: Bram and the Vector
author: Ada Montrose
blurb: Ivo Brightwater, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
